channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2026-75650 — Adobe Commerce and Magento
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source contain an improper neutralization of special elements used in a template engine vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2026-102764 — BeyondTrust Remote Support
item.description: Threat Signal 82. BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.

item.title: CVE-2026-59310 — Broadcom VMware vCenter
item.description: Threat Signal 86. Broadcom VMware vCenter contains a path traversal vulnerability which could allow a threat actor with network access to vCenter to execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2026-97229 — GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition
item.description: Threat Signal 80. GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contain a integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.

item.title: CVE-2026-102489 — Zammad GmbH Zammad
item.description: Threat Signal 73. Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.

item.title: CVE-2026-96655 — Plex Media Server
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to request arbitrary internal or external addresses via the '/video/:/transcode/universal' path parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96656.

item.title: CVE-2026-96652 — Plex Media Server
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability which could allow an attacker using any X-Plex-Token value to include a full URL in the 'protocol' parameter and force the Plex server to POST to the attacker's chosen destination. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96654, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

item.title: CVE-2025-54948 — Trend Micro Apex One
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Trend Micro Apex One Management Console (on-premise) contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow a pre-authenticated remote attacker to upload malicious code and execute commands on affected installations.

item.title: CVE-2026-76461 — Cisco Secure Email Gateway
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Cisco AsyncOS software for Cisco Secure Email Gateway (SEG) contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system.

item.title: CVE-2021-22893 — Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allow a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute code via license services.

item.title: CVE-2026-105133 — Ahsay AhsayCBS
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Ahsay AhsayCBS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass authentication via manipulation of the random parameter in the API component’s checkSysPwd function. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105134.

item.title: CVE-2022-41073 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Microsoft Windows Print Spooler contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an attacker to gain SYSTEM-level privileges.

item.title: CVE-2020-0638 — Microsoft Update Notification Manager
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Microsoft Update Notification Manager contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2025-41244 — Broadcom VMware Aria Operations and VMware Tools
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Broadcom VMware Aria Operations and VMware Tools contain a privilege defined with unsafe actions vulnerability. A malicious local actor with non-administrative privileges having access to a VM with VMware Tools installed and managed by Aria Operations with SDMP enabled may exploit this vulnerability to escalate privileges to root on the same VM.

item.title: CVE-2026-28318 — SolarWinds Serv-U
item.description: Threat Signal 67. SolarWinds Serv-U contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows specially crafted POST requests using the Content-Encoding: deflate header to crash the Serv-U service without authentication.

item.title: CVE-2026-21519 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Microsoft Desktop Windows Manager contains a type confusion vulnerability that could allow an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

item.title: CVE-2026-20128 — Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a storing passwords in a recoverable format vulnerability that allows an authenticated, local attacker to gain DCA user privileges by accessing a credential file for the DCA user on the filesystem as a low-privileged user.

item.title: CVE-2020-1040 — Microsoft Hyper-V RemoteFX
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Microsoft Hyper-V RemoteFX vGPU contains an improper input validation vulnerability due to the host server failing to properly validate input from an authenticated user on a guest operating system. Successful exploitation allows for remote code execution on the host operating system.

item.title: CVE-2026-73570 — Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS)
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains an OS command injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to send specially crafted SMTP requests that may result in execution of arbitrary operating system commands as the Zimbra user.

item.title: CVE-2026-76519 — Cisco Secure Email Gateway
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Cisco Secure Email Gateway contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying operating system.

item.title: CVE-2020-12271 — Sophos SFOS
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Sophos Firewall operating system (SFOS) firmware contains a SQL injection vulnerability when configured with either the administration (HTTPS) service or the User Portal is exposed on the WAN zone. Successful exploitation may cause remote code execution to exfiltrate usernames and hashed passwords for the local device admin(s), portal admins, and user accounts used for remote access (but not external Active Directory or LDAP passwords).

item.title: CVE-2026-20133 — Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains an exposure of sensitive information to an unauthorized actor vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to view sensitive information on affected systems.

item.title: CVE-2026-110936 — Siemens Software Center
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Siemens Software Center contains an uncontrolled search path element vulnerability that could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application.

item.title: CVE-2026-104935 — Ivanti Connect Secure
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

item.title: CVE-2022-21919 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 55. Microsoft Windows User Profile Service contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2026-0257 — Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS
item.description: Threat Signal 87. Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass security restrictions and establish an unauthorized VPN connection.

item.title: CVE-2024-27199 — JetBrains TeamCity
item.description: Threat Signal 87. JetBrains TeamCity contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow limited admin actions to be performed.

item.title: CVE-2024-41713 — Mitel MiCollab
item.description: Threat Signal 87. Mitel MiCollab contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow an attacker to gain unauthorized and unauthenticated access. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2024-55550, which allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to read arbitrary files on the server.

item.title: CVE-2024-51567 — CyberPersons CyberPanel
item.description: Threat Signal 87. CyberPanel contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute commands as root.

item.title: CVE-2024-24919 — Check Point Quantum Security Gateways
item.description: Threat Signal 87. Check Point Quantum Security Gateways contain an unspecified information disclosure vulnerability. The vulnerability potentially allows an attacker to access information on Gateways connected to the internet, with IPSec VPN, Remote Access VPN or Mobile Access enabled. This issue affects several product lines from Check Point, including CloudGuard Network, Quantum Scalable Chassis, Quantum Security Gateways, and Quantum Spark Appliances.

item.title: CVE-2023-43208 — NextGen Healthcare Mirth Connect
item.description: Threat Signal 87. NextGen Healthcare Mirth Connect contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution via a specially crafted request.

item.title: CVE-2024-21762 — Fortinet FortiOS
item.description: Threat Signal 87. Fortinet FortiOS contains an out-of-bound write vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute code or commands via specially crafted HTTP requests.

item.title: CVE-2023-27997 — Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy SSL-VPN
item.description: Threat Signal 87. Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy SSL-VPN contain a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability which can allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute code or commands via specifically crafted requests.

item.title: CVE-2019-7194 — QNAP Photo Station
item.description: Threat Signal 87. QNAP devices running Photo Station contain an external control of file name or path vulnerability allowing remote attackers to access or modify system files.

item.title: CVE-2017-18362 — Kaseya Virtual System/Server Administrator (VSA)
item.description: Threat Signal 87. ConnectWise ManagedITSync integration for Kaseya VSA is vulnerable to unauthenticated remote commands that allow full direct access to the Kaseya VSA database.

item.title: CVE-2019-16057 — D-Link DNS-320 Storage Device
item.description: Threat Signal 87. The login_mgr.cgi script in D-Link DNS-320 is vulnerable to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2017-9822 — DotNetNuke (DNN) DotNetNuke (DNN)
item.description: Threat Signal 87. DotNetNuke (DNN) contains a vulnerability that may allow for remote code execution via cookie deserialization.

item.title: CVE-2021-30116 — Kaseya Virtual System/Server Administrator (VSA)
item.description: Threat Signal 87. Kaseya Virtual System/Server Administrator (VSA) contains an information disclosure vulnerability allowing an attacker to obtain the sessionId that can be used to execute further attacks against the system.

item.title: CVE-2017-0143 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 87. Microsoft Windows Server Message Block 1.0 (SMBv1) contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2020-3992 — VMware ESXi
item.description: Threat Signal 87. VMware ESXi OpenSLP contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an attacker residing in the management network with access to port 427 to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-21589 — Atlassian Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 86. Multiple Atlassian products (Bitbucket Data Center ,Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye) contain a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions.

item.title: CVE-2026-50751 — Check Point Security Gateway
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Check Point Security Gateway contains an improper authentication vulnerability in IKEv1 key exchange that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass user authentication and establish a remote access VPN connection without a valid user password.

item.title: CVE-2024-1708 — ConnectWise ScreenConnect
item.description: Threat Signal 88. ConnectWise ScreenConnect contains a path traversal vulnerability which could allow an attacker to execute remote code or directly impact confidential data and critical systems.

item.title: CVE-2025-49704 — Microsoft SharePoint
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Microsoft SharePoint contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an authorized attacker to execute code over a network. This vulnerability could be chained with CVE-2025-49706. CVE-2025-53770 is a patch bypass for CVE-2025-49704, and the updates for CVE-2025-53770 include more robust protection than those for CVE-2025-49704.

item.title: CVE-2025-0282 — Ivanti Connect Secure, Policy Secure, and ZTA Gateways
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Ivanti Connect Secure, Policy Secure, and ZTA Gateways contain a stack-based buffer overflow which can lead to unauthenticated remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2024-40711 — Veeam Backup & Replication
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Veeam Backup and Replication contains a deserialization vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated user to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2020-0618 — Microsoft SQL Server
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Microsoft SQL Server Reporting Services contains a deserialization vulnerability when handling page requests incorrectly. An authenticated attacker can exploit this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the Report Server service account.

item.title: CVE-2024-21887 — Ivanti Connect Secure and Policy Secure
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Ivanti Connect Secure (ICS, formerly known as Pulse Connect Secure) and Ivanti Policy Secure contain a command injection vulnerability in the web components of these products, which can allow an authenticated administrator to send crafted requests to execute code on affected appliances. This vulnerability can be leveraged in conjunction with CVE-2023-46805, an authenticated bypass issue.

item.title: CVE-2023-41265 — Qlik Sense
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Qlik Sense contains an HTTP tunneling vulnerability that allows an attacker to escalate privileges and execute HTTP requests on the backend server hosting the software.

item.title: CVE-2021-45046 — Apache Log4j2
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Apache Log4j2 contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability due to the incomplete fix of CVE-2021-44228, where the Thread Context Lookup Pattern is vulnerable to remote code execution in certain non-default configurations.
